root_selection_decision.question: At fixed SC4 rounded physical mask/0.1mm SC, same XY/bulk/tissue/circuit and exact selected SC2 two-tone coefficients and five saved SC2 amplitudes, how do nominal PBS interface specificZ factors0.5 and2 change target mean/P10 and off-target/high-volume/J/contactV/loss/power/native-probe results? Separate rematching uses ORIGINAL SC2caps/I/P/cutoffs. No repeat Rs subtraction or area conversion, no claim of measured skin validation or statistical confidence interval.

holds: Complex specific contactZ0.5/2 times nominal PBS model is an uncertainty condition, not validated skin impedance or an optimized geometry
Relative changes are diagnostic without an arbitrary pass cutoff; original eight-screen outcomes are reported individually
Historical SC2 amplitudes do not imply current/power/cap equality on each contact condition; supplemental rematches use original SC2 references only
SC2/SC4 mesh sensitivity does not establish XY/bulk/edge/contact convergence, experiment, activation or human safety
Probes are unloaded; ETA5001 instrument loading, source absorption/compliance and phase hardware remain unverified
